design_description: The Drink Team jersey, representing a team from Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, uses a clean white-and-black football aesthetic with restrained gold detailing. The main body is white with a series of very thin, irregular vertical black pinstripes, combining continuous lines with small dotted interruptions. This gives the shirt a contemporary technical look while keeping the overall composition extremely clean. Solid black sleeves and collar provide strong contrast. Across the shoulders, parallel black, white and gold bands run from the collar toward the sleeves, with the narrow gold line adding a subtle premium accent and tying into the small sleeve detailing. The Drink Team crest sits traditionally over the heart in monochrome black and white, while the Momuto branding is positioned opposite in black. With no central sponsor dominating the torso, the pinstripe pattern remains the principal graphic element. Overall, it is a minimal, elegant and modern design: predominantly white, sharply framed in black, with fine vertical geometry and just enough gold to give Drink Team a distinctive identity without making the kit overly complex.
